title: TheGitAI: CLI and Desktop coding agent, with Computer Control through vision
excerpt: TheGitAI is an AI coding agent with a CLI and a desktop app that works in your signed-in Chrome and uses applications on your computer, under one account.
content_html:
CLI · Desktop · Browser · Computer

TheGitAI is an AI coding agent with a CLI and a desktop app that works in your signed-in Chrome and uses applications on your computer, under one account.

01Computer Control

Computer Control on macOS, Linux and Windows 11

TheGitAI operates applications on your computer directly, beyond files and shell commands. On Linux and macOS it runs on your screen or on a separate background screen, and on Windows 11 it runs on your screen. It works from both the CLI and the desktop app under the same account.

02Background screen

Background screen on Linux (including Wayland) and macOS

On Linux (including Wayland) and macOS, the agent can run apps on its own separate background screen while you keep using your computer. Keep typing, clicking and switching windows on your desktop while it works. Watch its screen, pause the run, or take over whenever you want.

03Desktop app

Desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux

Run the same coding agent in a dedicated desktop window across macOS, Windows and Linux, with conversations, files and changes side by side. Stage, discard and commit changes yourself, or ask the agent to handle branches, commits and pull requests. One account works across the desktop app and the CLI.

04Browser Control

Browser Control in your own signed-in Chrome

The TheGitAI Chrome extension connects to the Chrome browser you already use, keeping your existing signed-in sessions. The agent can work across web apps and verify its own changes in the real browser before handing a task back. Available from both the CLI and the desktop app.

05Voice dictation

Voice dictation in the CLI and desktop app

Talk instead of typing in either client. In the CLI, run /voice and hold Space to speak; in the desktop app, click the mic next to Send. Your words appear as you speak, and nothing is sent until you press Enter.

06

MCP servers

Connect local and remote MCP servers to bring external tools into the agent. Configured MCP tools are available across both the CLI and the desktop app, alongside built-in code, browser and computer tools.

07

Agent skills (SKILL.md)

Save repeatable workflows as SKILL.md files and run them from both the CLI and the desktop app. Reusable skills keep multi-step habits consistent across sessions, alongside your project AGENTS.md instructions.

08

Project and global memory

TheGitAI remembers your corrections, lasting preferences and decisions between sessions, scoped to a project or globally. Notes live as plain Markdown files on your machine, never stored on our servers, and you can read, edit or delete them at any time.

09Background jobs

Background jobs

Keep development servers, watchers and local APIs running while the conversation continues. The agent can start your stack and check the running app without blocking your turn, in both the CLI and the desktop app.

10Progress and notifications

Progress updates and notifications

On multi-step tasks, the agent researches in parallel, posts short progress updates as it works, and keeps a live to-do list of what is done and what comes next. When a turn finishes or waits for your answer, the CLI and the desktop app notify you.
